versions.changelog:
- No changes to `SKILL.md`; its content is unchanged.
- Removed `skill-card.md`.

Initial release of the translate-to-zh-hans skill.

- Provides on-demand translation of a specified article from `ai-thoughts/docs/` into Simplified Chinese, outputting to a new file with a `-zh-hans.md` suffix.
- Requires explicit user approval and selection of a single article before starting; never runs automatically or selects files on its own.
- Preserves code, product names, and technical terms verbatim; applies bilingual-gloss style by glossing technical terms and adding plain-language explanations.
- Confirms output path and overwrite behavior with the user before writing; never overwrites or modifies files silently.
- Handles existing translations, legacy naming (`-chn.md`), and ensures links, images, and markdown structure are preserved exactly.
- Includes robust error handling: prompts the user if article is unclear, missing, or ambiguous.
